meta.verified: sections 'raw_*' are verbatim game data [V]; 'laws' are transcribed from the decompiled C# [V] unless a value is listed under 'estimates' [E]

velocity_update_order: v *= max(0, 1 - drag*dt); w *= max(0, 1 - angDrag*dt)
engine.force_mode_acceleration: AddForce(a, Acceleration): dv = a*dt, mass ignored. AddTorque(t, Acceleration): dw = t*dt, inertia ignored. AddForceAtPosition(a, p, Acceleration): dv = a*dt AND dw = ((p - worldCoM) x a)*dt (inertia ignored)
engine.update_rate_forces: forces added in Update apply at the next physics step; Update laws scale by 60*Time.deltaTime so their per-step value is constant

spawn.size: s = Lerp(1.1, 1.2, BellCurve(U01)) * sizeMultiplier(1.0); 1/10000 chance of x0.1 (70%) or x2 (30%)
spawn.joint_drive_multiplier: M (spring and damper, X and YZ both = prefab X drive * M)

standing_handler.formula: a_up = ((min(fgn.y*downHillHelp,0)*0.2 + max(fgn.y*UpHillHelp,0))*0.1 + curve[state]((distanceToGround + selfOffset + |upHill|*0.05*staticAngleLowering + baseOffset + bob[state](sinceSwitchedStep/currentLowSwitchCap)) / s)) * muscleControl * 100; Torso += a_up*1.0 up, Head += a_up*0.3 up; only while isGrounded

wings.ray_origin: Wings transform = Torso pivot (GoToBodyPart targetPart Torso)
wings.formula: if lastRay.distance > 0: x = distance + cos((Time.time + time)*1)*hv; a = 55*flightCurve(x); Head += 0.5a up; Torso += a up; TouchGround(hit); then schedule next ray (1-step latency)

rotation_handler.formula: for Hip and Torso separately: alpha = -25*muscle*torsoAngleMult*clamp(angle_deg(look, fwd),0,15) * normalize(cross(look, fwd)) (rad/s^2, Acceleration); only while grounded

hand_joint.anchor: hand-rig pivot (Elbow_* pivot) placed on the fist grip point

dodge_move.direction: normalize(enemyTorso.position - rigs[0].position), 3D, recomputed every step (ignoreY and predictionAmount unused)
dodge_move.stacking: every swing adds 5 new sequences; no cancel; mean 1.9 active
dodge_move.first_force: in the attack frame (synchronous to the first yield), then once after every physics step (WaitForFixedUpdate)

melee_swing.per_frame: a = 10000*forceAmount*(2+1)*0.33*Time.deltaTime*swingDirection, AddForceAtPosition at fist ForcePoint (0.0092508,-0.013,0.002) fist-local, Acceleration
melee_swing.damage_window: from first frame to end of swing

weapon_force_animation.per_frame: a = 100*curve(1)*100*Time.deltaTime toward targetRig.position from fist (3D, every frame)

collision_weapon.k: clamp(|impulse|/(m_fist+10)*0.3*25, 0, 2); k<1 ignored; vs non-rigidbody: no +10
collision_weapon.knockback_dv_per_rig: 10*sqrt(50k) m/s along swingDirection on target mainRig and touched rig (Impulse with min-weight scaling)
collision_weapon.slow: if touched.mass < fist.mass: touched.v *= 0.6 and mainRig.v *= 0.6 before the impulse

targeting.sight_ray: from right fist transform to target torso, mask 0x72400200 (layers 9,22,25,28,29,30)
targeting.look_direction: normalize(target.groundPosition - own.torso.position) (3D, pitched down to the feet)

gravity_handler.formula: when !isGrounded: every body rig += 20*sinceGrounded m/s^2 down

laws.curve_animation: see raw_data_assets C_Arms/C_Elbow/C_Knees/C_Leg/C_Torso and the spec section 6.6; a = 60*multiplier(1.0)*Time.deltaTime*v*muscleControl, torque mode uses -a

foot_support.idle_strafe: both feet GroundChecker on, Foot material

state_machine.rule: dontMoveFor>0 -> Idle; input!=0: input.z<=0 -> Strafe, shift -> Run, else Walk; input==0: |torso.angularVelocity.y|>1 rad/s -> Strafe, else Idle (SetAnimationByInput, every Update)
state_machine.battle: visible target -> input 0 -> Idle/Strafe only; AI never sets shift

curve_animation_components._law: v = (data.isRight != isRight ? backward : forward) * curve(clamp(sinceSwitchedStep/clamp(cap,0.001,1),0,1)); space transform (Hip/Torso: y negated for !isRight); uppHill factor; A = 60*multiplier(1.0)*dt*v*muscle; torque: AddTorque(-A); force: AddForceAtPosition(A, ForcePoint) or AddForce(A)

estimates.E1_joint_sign: Unity ConfigurableJoint angular X angle = -(rotation of child about joint X) (inferred from limits; anatomically consistent)
estimates.E2_degenerate_secondary_axis: axis == secondaryAxis == (0,1,0) on the shoulders -> joint Y = (-1,0,0) local (Unity OrthoNormalVectorFast fallback)
estimates.E4_inertia_with_com_override: collider-derived inertia, either about the collider CoM (GEO values) or parallel-axis shifted to the override CoM; unverified
estimates.E5_drive_implicit: PhysX 4.1 soft-constraint (implicit spring) for joint drives
estimates.E6_static_friction: PhysX raises static friction to dynamic when static < dynamic
estimates.E7_perlin: Unity Mathf.PerlinNoise implementation not available; output ~[0,1]
estimates.E8_batched_order: registration (Start) order of batched behaviours: RigidbodyHolder, then Rigidbodies components in component order (StepHandler, DataHandler, StandingHandler, GravityHandler, Balance, MovementHandler, RotationHandler, SetAnimationByInput, HoldingHandler, DragHandler, WeaponHandler...), then rig components
estimates.E9_wings_ray_scene: the Wings RaycastCommand sees the scene as of scheduling (pre-step): result used one step later
estimates.E10_add_force_at_position: AddForceAtPosition(a, p, Acceleration) also adds (p - worldCoM) x a as an angular acceleration (inertia ignored)
estimates.E11_fist_mass_properties: fist CoM/inertia from the 4 boxes with uniform density per shape
estimates.E12_sim_numbers: hover heights, sink speeds, dash distances and cadence figures come from reduced/lumped sims

fo4_mapping.axial_vectors: angular velocity / torque / rotation axis built with Cross: fo4 = -(x, z, y)_unity
fo4_mapping.recommendation: simulate in Unity frame and SI units exactly as TABS, convert only at the bone-pose boundary
